##### Project general facts

Bloomingdales Villas is an exclusive gated community featuring a picturesque collection of stunning villas, all complementing each other in architecture and western design. This community offers residents a safe haven away from the hustle and bustle of everyday life. With four and five-bedroom options, the villas are carefully planned to allow room to grow, featuring spacious surrounds with modern built-in wardrobes in each room and a walk-in wardrobe in the master bedroom.

Built to the highest standards, every aspect of the villas has been carefully considered, from architect-designed living spaces to ventilated corridors and entry and exit points. A huge rooftop terrace, wide open spaces, thoughtful design, and premium finishes create the home and lifestyle your family deserves. Premium fixtures and fittings are featured throughout, including large floor tiles, stainless steel taps, porcelain washbasins, and glass shower basins that provide room to move and modern elegant finishes. The no-compromise-on-quality motto reigns true for every detail.

Kitchens are designed by Italian supplier Ciesse and fitted with premium Italian appliances from Elba, including built-in dishwasher, hood, hob, oven, microwave, double fridge, freezer, washing machine, and a breakfast bar for casual dining experiences. Every residence features premium finishes and thoughtful design, creating a home that meets the highest quality standards. From the spacious living areas to the elegant bathrooms, every detail reflects a commitment to excellence.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in Dubai Sports City, this exceptional location offers residents an unbeatable and unique lifestyle — a city within a city, underpinned with sports and leisure activities, with every possible amenity right on the doorstep. The community features four magnificent stadia, an 18-hole championship golf course, and the ICC Academy, creating a vibrant environment for families and individuals alike.

The location is distinguished by its excellent connectivity, situated off Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, the gateway to the rest of Dubai. Mall of the Emirates is just minutes away, the Marina is within easy reach, and Dubai Airport is accessible, making the location second to none. The city within a city caters for everyone, offering residential communities, superb dining, shopping, entertainment, and a vibrant commercial district.

For those seeking a residence that embodies quality, exclusivity, and a prime Dubai address, Dubai Sports City delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of world-class sporting facilities, strategic connectivity, and a vibrant community makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can escape into a haven of tranquility.
